plainTranslation: A's identity meets B's identity. The opposition pulls them into push-and-pull.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryDeep:
This person may have a way of approaching life that feels noticeably different from yours. They may make choices you would not make, focus on things you tend to overlook, or respond to situations from a completely different starting point. Part of what draws you to them may be that difference. Part of what frustrates you may be the same thing.

When this works, the difference can be surprisingly helpful. This person may show you another way of handling things, one that would not have occurred to you on your own. They can make you question old assumptions, consider a different approach, or appreciate strengths you usually overlook. You may not always understand where they are coming from at first, but over time they can broaden your sense of what is possible.

The harder part is when the difference stops feeling interesting and starts feeling frustrating. You do things one way, they do things another, and before long both of you are explaining, defending, or pushing back. What began as contrast can turn into a pattern where each person feels misunderstood by the other.

You do not have to agree on everything to respect each other. The difference becomes much easier to live with when neither person is trying to prove their way is the right one.
